_ask | low | chat_completion import from daedalus.providers._openai_compat may fail if module missing; exception caught but silent. | Ensure module exists or add fallback log.
run_tier2 | medium | cap_tokens parameter is 120,000 but docstring mentions cap_tokens * 4 chars; logic not shown in this chunk. | Verify truncation logic in context assembly.
run_tier2 | medium | tokens_B_true described as added but not defined in this chunk; may be elsewhere. | Check definition and usage in full file.

claims.text: Model-free (recall via ``_recall``), offline, no LLM -- safe to run alongside Tier 1.
claims.why: Refers to _recall and offline nature; not in this chunk.

claims.text: See ``eval_task_arms`` for what each arm measures and ``by_provenance`` for the (never-blended) per-provenance-tier breakdown.
claims.why: Functions not defined in this chunk.

claims.text: Success = every expected substring appears (case-insensitive). Also return the fraction present for a softer signal.
claims.why: Code checks all substrings case-insensitively and returns fraction.

claims.text: Only a local Ollama HTTP endpoint is probed (free, no key, no egress). The probe is a 2s GET to /api/tags -- it does nothing unless Tier 2 is requested.
claims.why: Code does GET /api/tags with 2s timeout; no egress to external hosts.

claims.text: Single text-only turn against the provider. Never raises to the caller.
claims.why: Wraps chat_completion in try/except, returns '' on failure.

claims.text: Opt-in Tier 2. Compares distilled-slice (A) vs whole-repo-concat (B) task success + tokens. Cleanly skipped (never crashes) when no provider is up.
claims.why: Logic for A/B comparison not shown; skip path returns dict with skipped=True.

claims.text: B's tokens were ALREADY measured with the real tokenizer before this change (``count_tokens`` is exact whenever tiktoken is installed) -- that part was honest. What was NOT honest: B is capped at ``cap_tokens * 4`` chars before being measured, so ``tokens_B`` silently reflected a TRUNCATED text, not the real whole-repo size. ``tokens_B_true`` (added here) is the untruncated whole-repo token count, so a truncated B can never be mistaken for the real baseline.
claims.why: Referenced variables (tokens_B, tokens_B_true) not present in this chunk.

observations.what: detect_provider uses urllib.request with hardcoded timeout 2; may block if host unresponsive.

run_tier2 docstring mentions cap_tokens*4 chars truncation but code for that not visible.
